title: REQ · Runtime source, content and tests live under game/
summary: All files from backend/game are moved to top-level game/ with identical internal layout
description: Context: backend/game contains package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts, src/{content,engine,state,systems}, content/worlds/the-boys-room and tests. Desired behavior: these files exist at game/ with the same relative paths and nothing remains in backend/game. Expected result: imports like ../src/content/loader and content paths like ../content/worlds/the-boys-room resolve unchanged. Why: top-level game module per the goal.
acceptance_criteria: Given the move, when listing game/, then src/engine, src/state, src/systems, src/content, content/worlds/the-boys-room, tests, package.json, tsconfig.json and vitest.config.ts exist
Given the move, when checking backend/, then backend/game does not exist
Given game/content/worlds/the-boys-room, when loadWorld runs on it, then it loads without validation errors

in_scope: moving all tracked files of backend/game
out_of_scope: editing file contents beyond path fixes
preserve: relative paths between src, tests and content
